key_concepts: Weather is the short-term condition of the atmosphere
Climate is the long-term weather pattern of an area
Weather patterns are repeating weather conditions over time
The Philippines has two distinct seasons: wet and dry
The wet season brings heavy rains, typhoons, and possible flooding
The dry season has hot clear skies and very little rainfall
The southwest monsoon or Hanging Habagat brings hot humid air and heavy rains
The northeast monsoon or Hanging Amihan brings cool dry air
The dry season is divided into cool dry and hot dry periods
Rainfall amount affects the seasons in the Philippines
PAGASA classifies rainfall as moderate or heavy based on amount per hour
In Metro Manila, rainfall is highest around August and lowest around February
